snippet.title: Alien Breed Trilogy - Trailer - for PC from Steam and Xbox 360
snippet.description:
Available now for PC from Steam http://store.steampowered.com/sub/7678 and as a boxed retail game on Xbox360 (published by Mastertronic across Europe) 

Alien Breed: Impact on Steam: http://bit.ly/ABSteam 
Alien Breed 2: Assault on Steam: http://bit.ly/AB2Steam 
Alien Breed 3: Descent on Steam: http://bit.ly/AB3Steam

http://www.mastertronic.com/productMastertronic.asp?pid=944&productLabelID=2
